draft_sentences_for_rewrite.risk_of_bias: Of the 32 records, ten were evaluations of automated screening; nine were retrospective simulations on completed reviews (one to 31 reviews each, and one study of 3434 reviews), three reported a held-out or independent test set, one reported a prespecified analysis, and none reported cost in the abstract, so most of the prior evidence is at risk of optimistic bias from tuning on the evaluation reviews and possible training-data contamination.
draft_sentences_for_rewrite.window: The search targeted evaluations of large language models since the public release of ChatGPT on Nov 30, 2022; the earlier machine-learning and stopping-rule literature is covered by references 2 to 8 and the scoping review (reference 3). Re-running the query without a start date added one record, dated 2021.
